name: Daimoinon — 3 Advanced — Summon the Herald of Topheth

system.description: A Master-level rite in which the Baali sacrifices at least three Blood Traits worth of blood and one permanent Willpower point to summon an infernal spirit (djinn, demon, angel, or efreet). The spirit possesses Attribute Traits of 10/7/3, six Willpower Traits, seven Ability Traits, ten Discipline Traits, at least Intermediate Fortitude, and regenerates a health level every other turn. At the Storyteller's discretion, a lapsed Baali may need to defeat the Herald in a Mental Test (retest with Occult) or become its vessel.
system.duration: Until task complete or three sunrises
